verses.text: I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”
lines: I was glad when they said to me,

verses.text: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem,
lines: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem,

verses.text: Jerusalem, that is built as a city that is compact together,
lines: Jerusalem, that is built as a city that is compact together,

verses.text: where the tribes go up, even Yah’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to Yahweh’s name.
lines: where the tribes go up, even Yah’s tribes,
according to an ordinance for Israel,
to give thanks to Yahweh’s name.

verses.text: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.
lines: For there are set thrones for judgment,

verses.text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.
lines: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem.
Those who love you will prosper.

verses.text: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
lines: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes,
I will now say, “Peace be within you.”

verses.text: For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God, I will seek your good.
lines: For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God,
